headline: How to Get a Cannabis Business Loan When the Bank Says No
description: Cannabis business loans depend on revenue, time in business and an active license, not just credit. See the minimums, five loan types and how to qualify.
keywords: cannabis business loans, cannabis loans, dispensary loans, cannabis lenders

mainEntity.name: Do I qualify for a cannabis business loan?

acceptedAnswer.text: You likely qualify if you've been in business at least 6 months, earn at least $250,000 a year, have a credit score above 500 and hold an active state cannabis license.

mainEntity.name: What are the best cannabis business loans for startups with low credit scores?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you've been open less than 6 months, most cannabis lenders will say no for now. After 6 months and $250,000 in annual revenue, credit scores above 500 can qualify for some products.

mainEntity.name: Which cannabis lenders offer flexible repayment terms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Payments are weekly or monthly, depending on the product and lender. Typical terms run from 8 months on a merchant cash advance to 7 years on a commercial real estate loan.

mainEntity.name: How do you get a business loan for a cannabis farm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Licensed cultivators use the same four minimums. Equipment financing is a common fit for grows, with an average deal of $70,000 over a typical 4-year term.

mainEntity.name: Will checking whether I qualify hurt my credit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The first check is a soft pull, which doesn't affect your credit score.
